scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:generator
scripts.format:generator: cd generator && venv/bin/ruff check --select I --fix . && venv/bin/ruff format .
scripts.check: npm run check:openapi && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:generator
scripts.check:generator: cd generator && venv/bin/ruff check --select I . && venv/bin/ruff format --check .
